commands.summary: TypeScript JSDoc checking completed without errors.
All 5 test files and 29 tests passed.

All 135 cases passed across 384/480/512px, 2/4/8/16/32 options, 40-character text, emoji, ZWJ graphemes, and combining marks. The exact 384px four-option probe returned alpha=[alpha] at 21px, beta=[beta] at 22px, gamma=[gamma] at 20px, and delta=[delta] at 21px.
Rendered a 407905-byte GIF in 3163ms; the generated fixture was removed after verification.

beforeAfter.before: The first wrapping implementation broke common short labels at 384px because it wrapped at base size before attempting a modest one-line shrink, and CSS padding was not subtracted from the measured width.
beforeAfter.after: The layout first fits a single line against padded content width, wraps only at the 8px floor when height allows, and preserves the radial track as the outer border-box width.
